# grouper_group (Resource)

Manages a Grouper group. Its folder must already exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "grouper_group" "admins" {
  name              = "org:dept:apps:admins"
  display_extension = "Administrators"
  description       = "People who administer the department's applications"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full name of the group, with segments separated by colons, such as `org:dept:apps:admins`. Changing the last segment renames the group, and changing its folder replaces it, since Grouper can't move groups.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the group.
- `display_extension` (String) Display name of the group itself, shown in the Grouper UI. Defaults to the last segment of `name`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the group's current full name. Grouper keeps a renamed group's old names as aliases, but they don't match here.
tofu import grouper_group.admins org:dept:apps:admins
```
